main_body: Large dark steel front panel (rows 22-47) with a purple orb core in the middle, topped by a stepped upper housing with two pillars
top_band: Reading the centre column: light grey band at rows 16-20 with a dark slot at rows 19-20. This is the vertical face of a raised back housing, not a horizontal top. Below it a 1-2 row light ledge at rows 21-22, then the dark front face.
evidence: The only horizontal element is a 1-2 px light ledge at rows 21-22, which reads as a rim. Everything else is a vertical face: the housing with its slot, the pillars and the big front panel. The orb and the rivets are painted flat on the surface and are not inset. No top surface is visible from above, so this is a front elevation with a thin ledge.

style.evidence: The front panel is a large area of almost uniform dark slate with only a few light rivet dots. The pillars and the housing are flat grey fills with 2-3 tones. The outline along the left and bottom edges is near-black and neutral. The purple orb has a few steps (gold rim, purple, lilac, pink), but the rest of the piece is much thinner than the stall and well references, which carry grain, per-element highlights and tinted dark outlines.
